title: tcmnetpharma: multi-source Traditional Chinese Medicine network pharmacology analysis toolkit

creators.name: Zheng, JianXiao
creators.affiliation: Haihe Laboratory of Modern Chinese Medicine, Tianjin University of Traditional Chinese Medicine

description:
tcmnetpharma is an R package for Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) network pharmacology. It provides data access, network construction, enrichment analysis and publication-quality visualisation (network / degree / Sankey / alluvial / circular / PPI / Venn / TF-target / heatmap) on top of a single herb–molecule–target knowledge base.

The knowledge base integrates nine upstream databases — TCMSP, HERB 2.0, BATMAN-TCM 2.0, ETCM2, ChEMBL 37, STRING 12, TRRUST v2, Open Targets Platform 25.06 and SymMap V2 — plus three offline gene-set sources (WikiPathways, Reactome, Gene Ontology). The 2025 edition of the Chinese Pharmacopoeia is used as a nomenclature and property reference only and is not redistributed. TTD (all rights reserved) and KEGG (proprietary) are not redistributed: KEGG enrichment is available as an online, user-side cached call that leaves no KEGG data in the package.

The runtime dataset (19 Apache Parquet tables, 182.3 MiB) is published separately and should be cited alongside this software: 10.5281/zenodo.23681367. It is not bundled in this source snapshot; retrieve it with Rscript tools/fetch-data.R.

Install: remotes::install_github("271705024/tcmnetpharma"). License: GPL-3.0-only for the code; the dataset carries CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 (non-commercial) and each upstream source keeps its own terms (see inst/extdata/DATA-README.md).
